Entry requirements · 2027 entry

Computer Science BS at Duke University

What Duke University asks of applicants to Computer Science BS for 2027 entry (the 2026–27 application cycle). Each requirement below is labelled verified, partly verified or not verified, with the date it was checked and a link to the official source.

US · All Duke University courses · Computer Science field guide

Entry requirements 2027 entry 7 of 8 verified
SAT / ACT
  • Test-optional for first-year and transfer applicants in the 2026–27 cycle, including international students
  • SAT/ACT scores are considered if submitted; self-reported scores are accepted
Verified19 Oct 2026Duke: Apply · Duke: Resources + FAQs
English language
  • English proficiency test recommended, not required, for non-native English speakers or students not in an English-medium curriculum
  • Minimum scores Duke expects if a test is taken: TOEFL iBT 100 (paper-delivered 75), IELTS 7, Duolingo 130, PTE Academic 70, Cambridge C1 Advanced/C2 Proficiency 180

Duke states these as minimum expected scores for a recommended (not required) test; no preference among tests, highest score used.

Verified19 Oct 2026Duke: Apply
Admissions tests

None listed on the official source

Duke’s 2026–27 first-year checklist lists transcript, school report, recommendations and optional SAT/ACT; no course-specific admissions test.

Verified19 Oct 2026Duke: Apply
Subject prerequisites
  • Not used in Altiora’s matching yet — see the note for the official guidance

Official: Duke recommends four years of English and at least three years of mathematics, natural sciences, world language and social studies (recommended, not required). The Pratt-only calculus requirement does not apply: this course is in Trinity College of Arts & Sciences.

Partly verified19 Oct 2026Duke: Apply
A-Level requirements
Grades
Not recorded
Details
A-level and similar national exam results are considered from students who choose to submit them (optional; self-reported results accepted for review).

Stated in the 2026–27 Undergraduate Instruction Bulletin; Duke’s admissions pages mention A-levels only for placement credit after enrolling.

Verified19 Oct 2026Duke: 2026–27 Undergraduate Instruction Bulletin — C.6. Admissions
IB requirements
Overall score
Not recorded
Details
IB scores are optional: considered if reported, and Duke asks students to self-report them in the application.
Verified19 Oct 2026Duke: Apply · Duke: Resources + FAQs
Other qualifications
  • Advanced Placement: AP scores are optional — considered if reported and self-reported in the application

AP/IB course credit and placement are granted only after admission (Registrar’s Office) and are not admission requirements, so they are not recorded here.

Verified19 Oct 2026Duke: Apply · Duke: Resources + FAQs
Other requirements
  • Apply to Trinity College of Arts & Sciences (this course) or the Pratt School of Engineering
  • Two required Duke short essays (250 words each) in 2026–27; further short essays optional
  • Alumni interviews: optional, not offered to all applicants
  • Arts supplement: optional
Verified19 Oct 2026Duke: Apply
